citations.quote: it is the difference between the cash flows for an actual portfolio and those of a hypothetical paper portfolio for which purchases and sales occur at benchmark prices

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Perold's implementation shortfall is the terminal-value gap between a costless paper portfolio and the actual portfolio, decomposing realized cost into execution cost on filled shares plus opportunity cost on the divergence between desired and actual holdings.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Implementation Shortfall: The Master Measure of Trading Cost
